# Tally

> Tally is private bilateral trade credit on Midnight. Amount and due stay in witnesses. Settled loans mint a relationship leaf. A membership proof answers yes or no only.

Live desk: https://tally-jet-mu.vercel.app
Network: Midnight Preprod
Contract: 84c44946900ca4ad4456518b09a42c01424dd8b626797310c5ed5b4b933b10af

Human navigation is in docs.json (Use vs Build). This file is the agent index. Prefer the `.md` mirror of each page.

## Use Tally
- [Introduction](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/index.md): what Tally is; the pipeline; Local vs Preprod.
- [Local quickstart](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Offer through Verifier Pass in about ten minutes. No wallet.
- [Desk tour](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/desk-tour.md): Local vs Preprod; Lace or 1AM; Lender / Borrower / Verifier.
- [Preprod guide](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/preprod.md): join the contract, wallets, proof server, faucet.
- [Verify access](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/verify/overview.md): third party checks a root; yes or no only.
- [Demo video](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/demo.md): placeholder — no recording yet.

## Concepts
- [How it works](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): Offer → Accept → Disburse → Repay → Settle → Prove standing.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/privacy.md): visible / not visible / what a verifier learns.
- [Standing](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/concepts/standing.md): allowlist leaf, Merkle root, membership proof.
- [Identity](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/identity.md): secret + PIN Desk ID. Not ownPublicKey().
- [Glossary](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/concepts/glossary.md): plain meaning → mechanism → owner page.
